[bold #D75FFF]◆ EPIC sase-1qz[/bold #D75FFF]
[dim]  Title: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]Agent Hijack: stop a stalled agent, keep its work, recover in one [/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]         [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]keypress[/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]A user can hijack a stalled sase agent (,k, the kill dialog's h, or[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]`sase agent hijack NAME`). Its process tree stops, but its [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]workspace claim, Agents-tab node, and evidence stay. The node shows[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]a ⏏ HIJACKED status, and <enter> opens a single-keypress recovery [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]panel: escalate to a smarter model, continue, or instruct in the [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]same workspace; restart or edit from a fresh workspace after a [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]verified snapshot; view the diff, open a shell, or dismiss. Every [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]path is durable, exactly-once, and fails closed so work is never [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]silently lost.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim] Counts: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]11[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] phases[dim][/dim] · [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]9[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] waves[/dim]
